review.what: An independent review of T2 (2026-09-30) found no lost or double wake and no RETRY or deadline defect. Fixed after it: the realtime clock flag answered ENOSYS on WAIT only (now on every operation, reported as unserved), WAKE with n <= 0 selected nobody (Linux wakes one), negative REQUEUE counts and misaligned words were not EINVAL, and the generation load had no acquire. Open for Q4/B11: a context revoked while parked leaves its record queued.
